L316: ### impl 【58†Write】 for &mut [【17†u8】]
L317: 
L318: Write is implemented for `&mut [u8]` by copying into the slice, overwriting its data.
L319: 
L320: Note that writing updates the slice to point to the yet unwritten part. The slice will be empty when it has been completely overwritten.
L321: 
L322: If the number of bytes to be written exceeds the size of the slice, write operations will return short writes: ultimately, `Ok(0)`; in this situation, `write_all` returns an error of kind `ErrorKind::WriteZero`.
